The BibTeX appendix block shows the Pandoc biblatex output as text. The title text `a&lt;b` becomes `a\&lt;b` in BibTeX and must not display as `a\<b`; `x&amp;nbsp;y` becomes `x\&amp;nbsp;y` and must not display as `x\&nbsp;y`. These words are not title-cased, so the entity-like sequences stay intact.
